## Planned search and table

The first public interface is planned as a static, client-side table for a literature-scale collection and will include:

- one global search box;
- sortable columns;
- pagination or virtual scrolling;
- horizontal scrolling for wide tables;
- a clear record-count display;
- a reset-search control; and
- optional column visibility controls if the finalized table is difficult to navigate.

The table will be progressively enhanced so that the site remains understandable without JavaScript. No synthetic scientific records will be used in the placeholder site.

## Planned record content

The draft project scope suggests that a future release may organize the following types of information:

- saRNA duplex information, including guide and passenger strands, sequence length, terminal overhangs, and reported chemical modifications;
- target context, including target gene, species, promoter or transcript-targeting context, and validated genomic annotations where available;
- experimental context, including cell type or model, concentration, delivery or transfection vehicle, treatment timing, assay timing, and formulation details;
- reported outcomes, preserving the activity assessment and readout context reported by the source; and
- provenance, including the source publication or patent, source notes, and later corrections.

These are draft-informed categories, not a finalized schema or released records. Final field names, inclusion rules, and identifier policies will be approved before publication.

## Future release information

Each release will identify its version, source workbook, CSV export, data dictionary, changelog, and Zenodo version record. The finalized Excel workbook will be the authoritative source for each release.
